Film your lights in slow-mo
Film your lights in slow-mo
Now look closely.
Some lights are pulsing,
100 or 120 times a second.
That is twice the rate
of the power in your wall.
Your eyes blur it into
a steady glow.
The camera's quick
snapshots catch the dips.
Good LEDs barely
flicker.
Cheap or dimmed ones
often do.
Go check yours.
